title: Dreams of a Coward Man
overview: Sidney, a student, and Nelly, a prostitute, meet at her apartment outside the context of her work. Both are insecure about what is to ensue, as it is Sidney's first time being with a woman, and Nelly's first time in years with a non-client. Their attempts to hide their insecurity fail as the evening moves forward. Will they manage to save the mess?
